# Course

## Summary
The reusable curriculum: modules in order plus completion rule, late policy and grade scale. Run many times as Cohorts. Publish Course is the status writer.

## Usage
Link modules; set the rules; publish. Mounts Course Outline.

## Non-goals
Holds no learners or dates — those are the Cohort's.
